import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "CUDA") || Pkg.add("CUDA")
using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

using JSON3

function initstacks_advection_multi_b(i_nnode, i_nstep)
    du_stack = Vector{Float64}(undef, (div(i_nstep - 1, 1) + 1) * (div(i_nnode - 2, 1) + 1))
    return du_stack
end

function advection_multi_b(u, ub, du, dub, c, cb, dx, dxb, dt, dtb, i_nstep, i_nnode, du_stack)
    for i_ = 1:i_nstep
        for i_x_advection_diff_c1 = 2:i_nnode
            du_stack[((i_ - 1) * (div(i_nnode - 2, 1) + 1) + (i_x_advection_diff_c1 - 2)) + 1] = du[i_x_advection_diff_c1]
            du[i_x_advection_diff_c1] = u[i_x_advection_diff_c1] - u[i_x_advection_diff_c1 - 1]
        end
        for i_x_advection_update_c2 = 2:i_nnode
            u[i_x_advection_update_c2] = u[i_x_advection_update_c2] - (c * dt * du[i_x_advection_update_c2]) / dx
        end
    end
    for i_ = i_nstep:-1:1
        for i_x_advection_update_c2 = i_nnode:-1:2
            cb = cb + (dt * du[i_x_advection_update_c2]) * ((1.0 / dx) * -(ub[i_x_advection_update_c2]))
            dtb = dtb + (c * du[i_x_advection_update_c2]) * ((1.0 / dx) * -(ub[i_x_advection_update_c2]))
            dub[i_x_advection_update_c2] = dub[i_x_advection_update_c2] + (c * dt) * ((1.0 / dx) * -(ub[i_x_advection_update_c2]))
            dxb = dxb + -((c * dt * du[i_x_advection_update_c2]) / dx ^ 2) * -(ub[i_x_advection_update_c2])
        end
        for i_x_advection_diff_c1 = i_nnode:-1:2
            du[i_x_advection_diff_c1] = du_stack[((i_ - 1) * (div(i_nnode - 2, 1) + 1) + (i_x_advection_diff_c1 - 2)) + 1]
            ub[i_x_advection_diff_c1] = ub[i_x_advection_diff_c1] + dub[i_x_advection_diff_c1]
            ub[i_x_advection_diff_c1 - 1] = ub[i_x_advection_diff_c1 - 1] + -(dub[i_x_advection_diff_c1])
            dub[i_x_advection_diff_c1] = 0.0
        end
    end
    return (cb, dxb, dtb)
end

function initstacks_advection_multi_b_cuda(i_nnode, i_nstep)
    du_stack = CuArray{Float64}(undef, (div(i_nstep - 1, 1) + 1) * (div(i_nnode - 2, 1) + 1))
    return du_stack
end

function advection_multi_b_cuda(u, ub, du, dub, c, cb, dx, dxb, dt, dtb, i_nstep, i_nnode, du_stack)
    cb = CuArray([cb])
    dtb = CuArray([dtb])
    dxb = CuArray([dxb])
    nthread_per_block = 256
    for i_ = 1:i_nstep
        @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_nnode - 2, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_advection_multi_b_1!(du, du_stack, i_, i_nnode, u)
        @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_nnode - 2, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_advection_multi_b_2!(c, dt, du, dx, i_nnode, u)
    end
    for i_ = i_nstep:-1:1
        @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(2 - i_nnode, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_advection_multi_b_3!(c, cb, dt, dtb, du, dub, dx, dxb, i_nnode, ub)
        @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(2 - i_nnode, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_advection_multi_b_4!(du, du_stack, dub, i_, i_nnode, ub)
    end
    cb = (Array(cb))[1]
    dtb = (Array(dtb))[1]
    dxb = (Array(dxb))[1]
    return (cb, dxb, dtb)
end

function cuda_kernel_advection_multi_b_1!(du, du_stack, i_, i_nnode, u)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_nnode - 2, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x_advection_diff_c1 = 2 + (__tid - 1)
    du_stack[((i_ - 1) * (div(i_nnode - 2, 1) + 1) + (i_x_advection_diff_c1 - 2)) + 1] = du[i_x_advection_diff_c1]
    du[i_x_advection_diff_c1] = u[i_x_advection_diff_c1] - u[i_x_advection_diff_c1 - 1]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_advection_multi_b_2!(c, dt, du, dx, i_nnode, u)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_nnode - 2, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x_advection_update_c2 = 2 + (__tid - 1)
    u[i_x_advection_update_c2] = u[i_x_advection_update_c2] - (c * dt * du[i_x_advection_update_c2]) / dx
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_advection_multi_b_3!(c, cb, dt, dtb, du, dub, dx, dxb, i_nnode, ub)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(2 - i_nnode, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x_advection_update_c2 = i_nnode + (__tid - 1) * -1
    CUDA.@atomic cb[1] += (dt * du[i_x_advection_update_c2]) * ((1.0 / dx) * -(ub[i_x_advection_update_c2]))
    CUDA.@atomic dtb[1] += (c * du[i_x_advection_update_c2]) * ((1.0 / dx) * -(ub[i_x_advection_update_c2]))
    dub[i_x_advection_update_c2] = dub[i_x_advection_update_c2] + (c * dt) * ((1.0 / dx) * -(ub[i_x_advection_update_c2]))
    CUDA.@atomic dxb[1] += -((c * dt * du[i_x_advection_update_c2]) / dx ^ 2) * -(ub[i_x_advection_update_c2])
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_advection_multi_b_4!(du, du_stack, dub, i_, i_nnode, ub)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(2 - i_nnode, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x_advection_diff_c1 = i_nnode + (__tid - 1) * -1
    du[i_x_advection_diff_c1] = du_stack[((i_ - 1) * (div(i_nnode - 2, 1) + 1) + (i_x_advection_diff_c1 - 2)) + 1]
    ub[i_x_advection_diff_c1] = ub[i_x_advection_diff_c1] + dub[i_x_advection_diff_c1]
    ub[i_x_advection_diff_c1 - 1] = ub[i_x_advection_diff_c1 - 1] + -(dub[i_x_advection_diff_c1])
    dub[i_x_advection_diff_c1] = 0.0
    return nothing
end

function _val_init_stacks_local(fn, extra_args)
    r = fn(extra_args...)
    r === nothing && return ()
    r isa Tuple && return r
    return (r,)
end

_relerr_scalar(a, b) = abs(a - b) / max(abs(a), abs(b), 1.0)
_relerr_arr(a, b) = maximum(abs.(a .- b) ./ max.(abs.(a), abs.(b), 1.0))

i_nstep = 3

__seed_du = [Float64[-0.08085909504441195, -0.49649529600675035, -0.2912048152650259, 1.2261014334998148], Float64[0.6952801123472513, -0.9188360087903269, -0.3693077118318738, 0.14143960188228788], Float64[-0.5010596882812559, 2.0920330988320597, -1.642937044054783, 1.4052083472071075]]
max_rel_err = 0.0
for __trial in 1:3
  u_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_u); u_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial])
  u_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_u)); u_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial]))
  du_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_du); du_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_du[__trial])
  du_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_du)); du_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_du[__trial]))

  stacks_cpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_advection_multi_b, Any[i_nnode, i_nstep])
  stacks_gpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_advection_multi_b_cuda, Any[i_nnode, i_nstep])
  ret_cpu = advection_multi_b(u_val_cpu, u_sh_cpu, du_val_cpu, du_sh_cpu, c_val_cpu, c_sh_cpu, dx_val_cpu, dx_sh_cpu, dt_val_cpu, dt_sh_cpu, i_nstep, i_nnode, stacks_cpu...)
  ret_gpu = advection_multi_b_cuda(u_val_gpu, u_sh_gpu, du_val_gpu, du_sh_gpu, c_val_gpu, c_sh_gpu, dx_val_gpu, dx_sh_gpu, dt_val_gpu, dt_sh_gpu, i_nstep, i_nnode, stacks_gpu...)
